meta.reference_column: jlayer (Jacobian lens J_l on the whole residual stream); layers 0..30 only, the Jacobian lens has no readout at the top block
meta.aggregation: best site: min over the 16 heads of a layer, then min over the region's layers; a head has no depth, so nothing is reduced per column index across layers
meta.raw_ranks_layout: {set}__{arm}: [n_items, max_intermediates, n_layers, n_heads] zero-based ranks, -1 = padding; jlayer has n_heads = 1; {set}__{arm}__control: the same concepts read on their control item's prompt
meta.sites_hit: mean over items of the mean over an item's intermediates of the number of sites ranking the intermediate within the top k (all layers); 'control' counts the same candidate tokens at the same sites on another item of the set, the next in a seeded random cycle whose own intermediates share no candidate token with the concept
meta.primary_statistic: paired J-head minus Logit-head difference: the mean over items of the per-item difference
meta.candidate_rule: both space-prefixed and bare spellings; for the sets in single_token_only_sets, only forms the tokenizer represents as exactly one token, which keeps the bare-space token out of the candidate set

magnitude.note: RMSNorm is scale-invariant, so a head contributing almost nothing still produces a confident-looking top-1. Every pass@k above describes the direction of a write this size, not its size.

structural.note: per-head excess kurtosis of the readout over the vocabulary, and workspace loading cos(z_{l,h}, v_{t,l,h}) against the concept the item specifies. Descriptive: a sharper, better-aligned readout is not a causal claim.
